def warmup_tokens_for(token_budget: int, seq_len: int) -> int:
    tokens = int(token_budget * PROCEDURAL_WARMUP_FRACTION)
    return tokens if tokens >= seq_len + 1 else 0


def run_train_stage(
    paths: RunPaths,
    model: MythosMini,
    model_config: ModelConfig,
    train_config: TrainConfig,
    cache_path: Path,
    token_budget: int,
    plan: BatchPlan,
    info: DeviceInfo,
    label: str,
) -> TrainState:
    buffer = GpuWindowBuffer(cache_path, train_config.seq_len, info.device, train_config.seed)
    saver = BackgroundSaver()
    run_log = RunLog(paths.logs / f"{label}.jsonl")
    bar = build_progress_bar(token_budget, label)
    deps = TrainerDeps(
        model=model,
        model_config=model_config,
        train_config=train_config,
        buffer=buffer,
        device_info=info,
        checkpoint_dir=paths.checkpoints,
        saver=saver,
        run_log=run_log,
        bar=bar,
    )
    state = run_training(deps, plan, token_budget)
    bar.close()
    run_log.shutdown()
    saver.shutdown()
    print(f"{label} done: {state.step} steps, {state.tokens_done} tokens")
    return state


def train_phase(
    paths: RunPaths, token_budget: int, quality_percent: float, info: DeviceInfo
) -> TrainState:
    model_config = ModelConfig()
    train_config = TrainConfig(token_budget=token_budget, quality_percent=quality_percent)
    model = MythosMini(model_config).to(info.device)
    print(f"model parameters: {count_parameters(model)}")
    plan = autotune_training_batch(model, train_config, info)
    print(f"autotuned micro batch {plan.micro_batch}, grad accum {plan.grad_accum}")
    warmup_tokens = warmup_tokens_for(token_budget, train_config.seq_len)
    if warmup_tokens > 0:
        proc_cache = build_procedural_cache(
            warmup_tokens,
            TOKEN_CACHE_DIR / f"procedural_n{warmup_tokens}.u16",
            PROCEDURAL_CACHE_SEED,
        )
        warmup_config = TrainConfig(token_budget=warmup_tokens, quality_percent=quality_percent)
        run_train_stage(
            paths, model, model_config, warmup_config, proc_cache, warmup_tokens, plan, info,
            "warmup",
        )
    cache_path = build_token_cache(quality_percent, CACHE_TARGET_TOKENS, TOKEN_CACHE_DIR)
    return run_train_stage(
        paths, model, model_config, train_config, cache_path, token_budget, plan, info, "training"
    )
